name: The Cuervo Group
tagline: Seasoned Expertise in Commercial Real Estate
description: The Cuervo Group provides clients and partners with seasoned expertise in commercial and residential real estate investment, development, property management, sales, leasing, and marketing in South Florida.
title: Principal
leaderBio: Led by principal Christina Cuervo, CG is comprised of proven South Florida real estate professionals. Christina devoted a large part of her career to community service through her role as assistant city manager of both the city of Miami and the city of Miami Beach.
mission: Our mission is to maximize profits, minimize headaches, and have a positive impact on every property and community that we engage.
